    // FITUR 1: ELUS KEPALA BISA TERUS-MENERUS, MISI HARIAN 10X PER HARI (+5 KOIN PER ELUSAN)

    async function handlePetHeadPat() {

      if (!roomData.pet) return;

      const now = Date.now();

      if (roomData.pet.exercisingUntil && now < roomData.pet.exercisingUntil) {

        document.getElementById("petSpeechBubble").textContent = t("petExercisingMsg");

        return;

      }

      const pet = { ...roomData.pet };

      pet.happiness = Math.min(100, (pet.happiness || 80) + 2);

      pet.exp = (pet.exp || 0) + 2;

      if (pet.exp >= 100) {

        pet.level = (pet.level || 1) + 1;

        pet.exp -= 100;

      }

      roomData.pet = pet;

      const rewarded = await tryClaimDailyMission("headPat", 5, { pet });

      const missionState = getMyDailyMissionState();

      const speech = rewarded

        ? `Woof! ${pet.name} sayang ${getMyName()} ♡ (+5 🪙 • ${missionState.headPatCount}/10)`

        : t("petHeadDailyLimitMsg", { pet: pet.name, name: getMyName() });

      triggerPetJumpAnimation(speech);

      renderPetView();

    }

    document.getElementById("petStageBox").addEventListener("click", handlePetHeadPat);

    // FITUR 2: JALAN-JALAN / OLAHRAGA 12 JAM MENURUNKAN 12 KEKENYANGAN

    document.getElementById("walkPetBtn").addEventListener("click", async (e) => {

      e.stopPropagation();

      if (!roomData.pet) return;

      const now = Date.now();

      if (roomData.pet.exercisingUntil && now < roomData.pet.exercisingUntil) {

        document.getElementById("petSpeechBubble").textContent = t("petExercisingMsg");

        return;

      }

      const pet = { ...roomData.pet };

      pet.exercisingUntil = now + EXERCISE_DURATION_MS;

      pet.lastFedBy = getMyName();

      roomData.pet = pet;

      document.getElementById("petSpeechBubble").textContent = t("petExercisingMsg");

      renderPetView();

      await saveRoomPatch({ pet });

    });

    async function feedPetWithItem(item) {

      if (!roomData.pet) return;

      const now = Date.now();

      if (roomData.pet.exercisingUntil && now < roomData.pet.exercisingUntil) {

        alert(t("petExercisingMsg"));

        return;

      }

      const currentCoins = getCurrentCoins();

      if (currentCoins < item.cost) {

        alert(t("notEnoughCoins"));

        return;

      }

      const nextCoins = currentCoins - item.cost;

      const pet = { ...roomData.pet };

      // Maksimum kekenyangan sekarang adalah 150

      pet.fullness = Math.min(150, (pet.fullness ?? 80) + item.full);

      pet.happiness = Math.min(100, (pet.happiness ?? 50) + item.happy);

      pet.exp = (pet.exp || 0) + item.exp;

      while (pet.exp >= 100) {

        pet.level = (pet.level || 1) + 1;

        pet.exp -= 100;

      }

      if (pet.fullness > 100 && !pet.obesitySince) {

        pet.obesitySince = now;

      }

      if (pet.fullness >= 50) {

        pet.malnutritionSince = 0;

      }

      pet.lastFedBy = getMyName();

      pet.lastFedAt = now;

      roomData.coins = nextCoins;

      roomData.pet = pet;

      triggerPetJumpAnimation(`Yum! ${item.icon} Terima kasih ${getMyName()}! ♡`);

      renderPetView();

      await saveRoomPatch({ coins: nextCoins, pet });

    }

    // FITUR 4: GANTI NAMA (1X) & TELANTARKAN ANJING

    document.getElementById("renamePetBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {

      if (!roomData.pet || roomData.pet.nameChanged) return;

      document.getElementById("renamePetInput").value = roomData.pet.name || "";

      document.getElementById("renamePetModal").style.display = "flex";

    });

    document.getElementById("cancelRenamePetBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {

      document.getElementById("renamePetModal").style.display = "none";

    });

    document.getElementById("confirmRenamePetBtn").addEventListener("click", async () => {

      if (!roomData.pet || roomData.pet.nameChanged) return;

      const newName = document.getElementById("renamePetInput").value.trim().slice(0, 16);

      if (!newName) return;

      const pet = {

        ...roomData.pet,

        name: newName,

        nameChanged: true

      };

      roomData.pet = pet;

      document.getElementById("renamePetModal").style.display = "none";

      renderPetView();

      await saveRoomPatch({ pet });

    });

    document.getElementById("abandonPetBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {

      if (!roomData.pet) return;

      document.getElementById("abandonPetModal").style.display = "flex";

    });

    document.getElementById("cancelAbandonPetBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {

      document.getElementById("abandonPetModal").style.display = "none";

    });

    document.getElementById("confirmAbandonPetBtn").addEventListener("click", async () => {

      document.getElementById("abandonPetModal").style.display = "none";

      roomData.pet = null;

      document.getElementById("petNameInput").value = "";

      renderBreedSelectionCards();

      renderPetView();

      await saveRoomPatch({ pet: null });

    });

    function renderPetView() {

      updatePetCoinsUI();

      const adoptSec = document.getElementById("petAdoptionSection");

      const careSec = document.getElementById("petCareSection");

      const now = Date.now();

      if (!roomData.pet || !roomData.pet.breed) {

        adoptSec.style.display = "block";

        careSec.style.display = "none";

        renderBreedSelectionCards();

        const deathBanner = document.getElementById("deathCooldownBanner");

        const adoptBtn = document.getElementById("adoptPetBtn");

        if (roomData.petDeathUntil && now < roomData.petDeathUntil) {

          deathBanner.style.display = "block";

          deathBanner.textContent = t("deathCooldownMsg", {

            time: formatRemainingDuration(roomData.petDeathUntil - now)

          });

          adoptBtn.disabled = true;

        } else {

          deathBanner.style.display = "none";

          adoptBtn.disabled = false;

        }

        return;

      }

      adoptSec.style.display = "none";

      careSec.style.display = "grid";

      const pet = roomData.pet;

      const breedInfo = PET_BREEDS[pet.breed] || PET_BREEDS.shiba;

      const isExercising = Boolean(pet.exercisingUntil && now < pet.exercisingUntil);

      document.getElementById("petLevelBadge").textContent = `Lv. ${pet.level || 1}`;

      document.getElementById("petDisplayName").textContent = pet.name || "Mochi";

      document.getElementById("petBreedLabel").textContent = `${breedInfo.name} (${breedInfo.sub.split("•")[0].trim()})`;

      const ageInfo = getPetRealAgeInfo(pet.adoptedAt);

      document.getElementById("petAgeStageBadge").textContent = ageInfo.badgeText;

      const svgContainer = document.getElementById("petSvgContainer");

      svgContainer.innerHTML = getPetSvgMarkup(breedInfo.id, ageInfo.stage);

      svgContainer.classList.toggle("exercising-walk", isExercising);

      const fullness = Math.max(0, Math.min(150, pet.fullness ?? 80));

      const happiness = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pet.happiness ?? 85));

      const exp = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pet.exp ?? 0));

      // Visual perubahan tubuh gemuk per tiap 10 angka di atas 100

      const obesityTier = getObesityTier(fullness);

      const scaleX = fullness < 50 ? 0.91 : 1 + (obesityTier * 0.085);

      const scaleY = fullness < 50 ? 0.94 : 1 + (obesityTier * 0.025);

      const svgOuter = document.getElementById("petSvgOuter");

      svgOuter.style.transform = `scale(${scaleX.toFixed(3)}, ${scaleY.toFixed(3)})`;

      svgOuter.style.filter = fullness < 50 ? "saturate(0.55) brightness(0.9)" : "none";

      // Pill indikator status kesehatan / olahraga

      const alertPill = document.getElementById("petStatusAlertPill");

      alertPill.className = "pet-status-alert-pill";

      if (isExercising) {

        alertPill.style.display = "block";

        alertPill.classList.add("info-exercising");

        alertPill.textContent = t("exercisingWarn", { time: formatRemainingDuration(pet.exercisingUntil - now) });

        document.getElementById("petSpeechBubble").textContent = t("petExercisingMsg");

      } else if (fullness > 100) {

        alertPill.style.display = "block";

        alertPill.classList.add("warn-obesity");

        alertPill.textContent = t("obesityWarn", { tier: obesityTier });

      } else if (fullness < 50) {

        alertPill.style.display = "block";

        alertPill.classList.add("warn-malnutrition");

        alertPill.textContent = t("malnutritionWarn");

      } else {

        alertPill.style.display = "none";

      }

      document.getElementById("petFullnessText").textContent = `${fullness} / 100 (Maks 150)`;

      const fullnessBar = document.getElementById("petFullnessBar");

      fullnessBar.style.width = `${Math.min(100, (fullness / 150) * 100)}%`;

      fullnessBar.style.background = fullness > 100 ? "#fb923c" : fullness < 50 ? "#f87171" : "var(--butter)";

      document.getElementById("petHappinessText").textContent = `${happiness} / 100`;

      document.getElementById("petHappinessBar").style.width = `${happiness}%`;

      document.getElementById("petExpText").textContent = `${exp} / 100 EXP`;

      document.getElementById("petExpBar").style.width = `${exp}%`;

      // Tombol elus kepala (bisa terus menerus, misi koin 10x per hari) & jalan-jalan

      const missionState = getMyDailyMissionState();

      const headBtn = document.getElementById("petHeadBtn");

      if (isExercising) {

        headBtn.disabled = true;

        headBtn.textContent = t("petHeadBtn");

      } else {

        headBtn.disabled = false;

        headBtn.textContent = missionState.headPatCount < 10

          ? `${t("petHeadBtn")} (${missionState.headPatCount}/10)`

          : `🖐️ Elus Kepala (10/10 ✓)`;

      }

      const walkBtn = document.getElementById("walkPetBtn");

      walkBtn.disabled = isExercising;

      walkBtn.textContent = isExercising

        ? `🏃 ${formatRemainingDuration(pet.exercisingUntil - now)}`

        : t("petWalkBtn");

      // Tombol ganti nama 1x

      const renameBtn = document.getElementById("renamePetBtn");

      renameBtn.disabled = Boolean(pet.nameChanged);

      renameBtn.textContent = pet.nameChanged ? t("renamedDoneLabel") : t("renameBtnLabel");

      // Toko makanan

      const shopGrid = document.getElementById("petShopGrid");

      shopGrid.innerHTML = "";

      PET_SHOP_ITEMS.forEach(item => {

        const card = document.createElement("div");

        card.className = "shop-item-card";

        card.innerHTML = `

          <div class="shop-item-top">

            <span class="shop-item-icon">${item.icon}</span>

            <div>

              <div class="shop-item-name">${escapeHtml(item.name[currentLang] || item.name.id)}</div>

              <div class="shop-item-effect">+${item.full}🍖 +${item.happy}💖 +${item.exp}EXP</div>

            </div>

          </div>

          <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" style="width:100%; font-size:0.75rem;" ${isExercising ? "disabled" : ""}>

            Beri (🪙 ${item.cost})

          </button>

        `;

        card.querySelector("button").addEventListener("click", () => feedPetWithItem(item));

        shopGrid.appendChild(card);

      });

      // Misi harian (1x sehari, kecuali elus kepala 10x sehari)

      const missionList = document.getElementById("petMissionList");

      const photoDone = missionState.photoCount >= 1;

      const noteDone = missionState.noteCount >= 1;

      const patDone = missionState.headPatCount >= 10;

      missionList.innerHTML = `

        <div class="mission-row">

          <span>📸 Kirim Polaroid (${Math.min(1, missionState.photoCount)}/1 hari ini)</span>

          <span class="mission-reward-tag ${photoDone ? "done" : ""}">${photoDone ? "Selesai ✓" : "+25 🪙"}</span>

        </div>

        <div class="mission-row">

          <span>🗒️ Tulis Sticky Note (${Math.min(1, missionState.noteCount)}/1 hari ini)</span>

          <span class="mission-reward-tag ${noteDone ? "done" : ""}">${noteDone ? "Selesai ✓" : "+15 🪙"}</span>

        </div>

        <div class="mission-row">

          <span>🖐️ Elus Kepala (${missionState.headPatCount}/10 hari ini • +5 🪙/elus)</span>

          <span class="mission-reward-tag ${patDone ? "done" : ""}">${patDone ? "Selesai ✓" : "+5 🪙"}</span>

        </div>

      `;

      if (pet.lastFedBy) {

        document.getElementById("lastPetCareLog").textContent = `✨ Terakhir dirawat oleh ${pet.lastFedBy}`;

      }

    }

    // ================= 15. FIREBASE REALTIME + STARTUP RECOVERY =================

    function startFirebaseRealtimeAndBackgroundSync() {

      if (!db || !session.roomCode) return;

      if (activeRoomRef) activeRoomRef.off("value");

      if (backgroundPollTimer) clearInterval(backgroundPollTimer);

      activeRoomRef = db.ref(`rooms/${session.roomCode}`);

      activeRoomRef.on("value", (snap) => {

        processIncomingSnapshot(snap.val());

      });

      backgroundPollTimer = setInterval(() => {

        pullLatestRoomState();

      }, 8000);

    }

    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {

      if (document.visibilityState === "visible" && session.roomCode) {

        pullLatestRoomState();

        autoRefreshGpsIfPermitted();

      }

    });

    window.addEventListener("focus", () => {

      if (session.roomCode) {

        pullLatestRoomState();

      }

    });

    // Simpan state sesi & halaman aktif secara otomatis saat pindah aplikasi / refresh ("Ingat Saya")

    function persistRememberMeSession() {

      if (!session || !session.roomCode || !session.myName) return;

      try {

        localStorage.setItem("virtual_desk_fb_session", JSON.stringify({

          ...session,

          lastMainPage: activeMainPage,

          lastPolaroidTab: activePolaroidTab,

          rememberedAt: Date.now()

        }));

        localStorage.setItem("virtual_desk_cached_room", JSON.stringify(roomData));

      } catch {}

    }

    window.addEventListener("pagehide", persistRememberMeSession);

    window.addEventListener("beforeunload", persistRememberMeSession);

    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {

      if (document.visibilityState === "hidden") {

        persistRememberMeSession();

      }

    });

    (function tryRestoreSession() {

      try {

        applyLanguageUI();

        const saved = localStorage.getItem("virtual_desk_fb_session");

        if (!saved) {

          connectGate.style.display = "flex";

          return;

        }

        const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);

        if (!parsed.roomCode || !parsed.myName) {

          localStorage.removeItem("virtual_desk_fb_session");

          connectGate.style.display = "flex";

          return;

        }

        let cachedData = {};

        try {

          cachedData = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("virtual_desk_cached_room") || "{}");

        } catch {}

        enterConnectedRoom(

          parsed.roomCode,

          parsed.pin || "",

          parsed.pinHash || "",

          parsed.seat || "p1",

          parsed.myName,

          cachedData

        );

        // Kembalikan ke tab halaman terakhir (Meja Polaroid atau Ruang Peliharaan)

        if (parsed.lastMainPage === "pet") {

          switchMainPage("pet");

        } else {

          switchMainPage("desk");

          if (parsed.lastPolaroidTab && ["upload", "self", "partner"].includes(parsed.lastPolaroidTab)) {

            switchPolaroidTab(parsed.lastPolaroidTab);

          }

        }

      } catch (err) {

        console.error("Startup recovery:", err);

        deskApp.style.display = "none";

        connectGate.style.display = "flex";

      }

    })();

  </script>

</body>

</html>
